words.said: What if it instead is the memory of a company?
words.how: A boxed company-memory column with a shared mailbox flow, plus buyers, existing products, a difference from EpicTeam and a recommendation.

visual.summary: Both widths open on the punchline box, show a clear three-column flow diagram, have no sideways overflow and a consistent look; the card and page are readable.

reader.asked: Decide whether to run a two-week company memory test, which the card recommends as yes.
reader.note: "You pick a business, we run it." A stranger could read "we" as the team running the test for free, or as Jordi having to find and set up the business himself.](The second reading would change what he must do before answering, but not the yes/no decision.)
